# MechIntel

> Free, browser-based engineering career assessment and planning tools. Mechanical engineering is covered in depth, with guides for 11 related engineering fields. Scores and benchmark comparisons are deterministic models, not hiring predictions or real applicant data.

## Main tools

- [Custom Shaft Spacer Generator](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/engineering-careers/shaft-spacer-generator.html): Local CPU-only nominal geometry, dimensioned preview, volume and solid mass calculation, OpenSCAD and millimetre DXF profile downloads. No API, GPU or remote processing.
- [Shim Washer Generator](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/engineering-careers/shim-washer-generator.html): Original parametric annular shim geometry and offline OpenSCAD/DXF export.
- [Bearing Spacer Clearance Calculator](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/engineering-careers/bearing-spacer-clearance-calculator.html): Nominal and worst-case axial clearance for two equal bearings and one spacer inside a housing, with stated assumptions.

- [GATE Mechanical Engineering Books](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/engineering-careers/gate-mechanical-books.html): Four original AI-assisted revision books covering selected foundations in mathematics, applied mechanics and design, thermal and fluid sciences, and manufacturing and industrial engineering. Sixteen chapters, sixteen worked examples, thirty-two original practice questions with reasoning. Searchable full text, offline Markdown and HTML downloads, browser print to PDF. Independent learning material; not official GATE questions or complete syllabus coverage. CC BY 4.0.

- [Mechanical CAD Library](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/engineering-careers/cad-library.html): 248 original educational parts including tapered, rounded and thin-wall profile studies with STL meshes and editable OpenSCAD sources, released under CC0. All dimensions are millimetres; no STEP, tolerances, or load ratings.

- [Mechanical Engineering Portfolio Project Planner and Resume Bullet Builder](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/engineering-careers/mechanical-engineering-portfolio-planner.html): Four educational project briefs with requirements, deliverables, verification prompts, and editorial effort estimates. Drafts factual resume bullets from user-entered details. Runs locally with no tokens or persistence.

- [Mechanical Engineering Resume–Job Match Checker](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/engineering-careers/mechanical-engineering-resume-checker.html): Free local technical keyword comparison with explicit aliases, resume excerpts, evidence prompts, and downloadable report. Coverage is not an ATS score.

- [Engineering Career Assessment](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/): Build a profile, review skill gaps and role matches, explore learning content, and plan next steps.
- [Resume Builder and ATS Review](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/): Create a structured resume draft from user-provided facts. Resume parsing and deterministic drafting run in the browser; no generative AI token or GPU is used.
- [Career Path Simulator](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/): Compare a profile with a selected engineering pathway, adjust study hours and plan duration, and review suggested milestones. The projection is a planning estimate, not a hiring forecast.
- [Engineering Career Guides](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/engineering-careers/): Searchable guides and browser-based profile assessment across 12 engineering fields.
- [Mechanical Engineering Guide](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/engineering-careers/mechanical.html): Mechanical engineering roles, skills, software, standards, and portfolio evidence.
- [Scoring and Benchmark Methodology](https://chamanprakashkanth.github.io/Mechanical-Engineering-Market-Position-Dashboard/engineering-careers/methodology.html): Explains score weights and generated comparison pool sizes. Profiles are deterministic simulations, not real or anonymized candidate records.

## Privacy and limitations

- Resume text is processed in the browser and is not sent to a MechIntel backend. The main dashboard may save progress in browser storage.
- Scores, salary ranges, role matches, and simulated ranks are directional educational outputs. They are not live labor-market statistics, employer ratings, or guarantees of interviews, hiring, or compensation.
- Job search links open external job boards; MechIntel does not scrape or import live job listings.
